scope: Existing owner corpus and source only; no vehicle, adb, network, task/stock-service start, token/credential acquisition, decoding of encrypted wrappers, firmware execution or OTA access

newFacts.claim: Default MainApp holder registers EOL_PRODUCT_LINE via MqttServiceManager and forwards IBYDCloudMqttListener bytes into the EOL v3 download/run runners.
EOL_DEV and EOL_PRODUCT_LINE both use V2 RX1037/TX1038 and V1 topics21/23. Di5.1 selects V2. The channel alone does not identify the backend sender.
finishStation sets FINISH; if every station is FINISH, stopTask removes persisted task, station sessions, whole Scripts cache and persistent outgoing queue, regardless of needClearData.
init with no saved task clears task data. If sold gate applies, manager init calls stopTask before listener registration. Starting the app is not a passive acquisition of old cache.
needClearData=true additionally deletes the station directory at run finish; explicit remote cleanup and timeout can also reach deletion.

Result.report.scriptInfo and status/failure scriptList contain code/version/station before encryption, unlike transient afterRunRes command data. Debug report and response logs include the tuple. No applicable report was recovered.

Outgoing messages are saved before send and removed on success. clearSendCache copies to RAM, clears persistent entries, then schedules up to8 resend iterations; it is not a durable post-task archive.

DownloadResponseVO.systemIds is EcuInfo(systemId,priority,funcType); this source schema has no software/calibration matrix. A backend VIN selector or script-step identity conditions remain possible and unobserved.

localFilenameAudit.pattern: Scripts/SpotIns path components; -script.txt/-script.json basenames; exact SpotInspection preference XML basename
localFilenameAudit.limits: Named paths only; no conclusion about opaque archives, innocuously named payloads, vehicle private storage or later concurrent additions

exactNextAcquisition.object: Already legitimate OEM/factory original plaintext script plus metadata sibling and redacted applicability manifest from its holder
exactNextAcquisition.tupleLead: Existing original factory report/status payload or original factory-side selection manifest; do not initiate a task to manufacture one

limitations: Source control flow is not evidence that a real task took the path or that cleanup caused current empty cache
Possible RemoteSystemEnum sender labels do not identify an observed sender
No source supplies the target exact dictionary or converts format01 for product use
Result tuple does not supply original dtcList or establish software applicability
No claim uses the ambiguous decompiled nonempty-list branch of syncStationScript
Previous broad resource/content/log audits are reused and pinned, not represented as new scans
